user.title: Connect Phare Protect
user.description: Create a personal access token in the Phare Protect app (Settings → API tokens) and paste it here. A token with the control scope lets Home Assistant arm, test and silence your devices.

data_description.base_url: Leave as is unless Phare Labs told you otherwise.

reauth_confirm.title: Your Phare token no longer works
reauth_confirm.description: It was revoked, expired, or your plan changed. Create a new token in the Phare Protect app and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: The token was refused. Check it was copied in full and has not been revoked.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Phare API.
error.https_required: The API base URL must start with https://.

abort.already_configured: This Phare account is already set up.
abort.wrong_account: That token belongs to a different Phare account.
